title: Finite projected root filtration supplies only a quadratic comparison candidate
question: Can a finite projected support filtration turn the side-16 F_ref QFT comparison process into the heat-root and root-filtration owner required by R-192?
method: Define the side-16 one-dimensional slice G=Z/16Z, S0={1,2}, C(S)=S+2(S-S) modulo 16, and V_j as Fourier-support subspaces of S_j.
Derive S1 and S2 by exact integer set arithmetic and independently reconstruct the same supports with a stdlib-only Fraction lane.
Define the quadratic-core diagonal rate omega(n)=r+Z*(2*pi*n/16)^2+Y*(2*pi*n/16)^4 and prove its positive rational lower bound r-Z^2/(4Y).
Use Lean to prove the general diagonal support-preservation lemma and the exact positive lower-bound identity; run primary, independent, integrated and direct Lean checks.
finding: The projected candidate is exact on the declared finite slice: S0=[1,2], S1=[0,1,2,3,4,15], and S2 is all residues 0 through 15. Thus V0 is properly nested in V1 and V2, the local nonlinear support rule raises V_j to V_(j+1), and the diagonal quadratic heat proxy preserves every V_j. The lower bound is 26000000000947494031/100000000000000000000>0. This supplies a finite projected-filtration and quadratic-core heat-root candidate only; it does not supply a nonlinear production heat-root law, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, or one-use q-ledger.
decision_reason: A diagonal Fourier multiplier preserves support by construction, but static F_ref data do not select that multiplier as the canonical nonlinear production mobility, and a deterministic support projection is not a conditional replica law. The one-dimensional slice is not the full three-dimensional A1 cylinder. Promoting this candidate would therefore bypass the R-192 owner contract rather than advance it.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite comparison only. No R-192 completion, A13/T-050 closure, interacting measure, OS/KMS or real-time result, physical-empty ordering, removal, continuum, thermodynamic, Sector-A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
next_action: Keep this finite projected object as a comparison baseline. Advance R-192 only after a hash-pinned full A1 nonlinear heat-root law, conditional replica construction, raw-current spatial identity and one-use nonnegative q-ledger are supplied on the complete production cylinder.
